title_en: 3+1 apartment for sale on New Boulevard!
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale on New Boulevard! We are selling a 3+1 apartment on Ri Boulevard! It is located on the 4th floor of one of the buildings of the Orbital complex. It is arranged in a living room and kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a laundry room, two balconies. Oriented South-East. It has a well-designed and functional floor plan. There is also a parking post on the -1st floor at an extra cost. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us
